purpose: Provide a quick review rubric for the retained execution-required and global timer local-KD symbol-hunt artifacts.

outcome_mapping.review_rule: Choose this outcome when the init-walker and consumer passes still retain the known execution-required globals, wrappers, and consumer chain cleanly enough to preserve the narrow seeding hypothesis.
outcome_mapping.next_move: Keep the lane on the retained init-walker hypothesis and avoid widening into another broad runtime replay.

outcome_mapping.review_rule: Choose this outcome when the setting-callback pass cleanly re-proves the timeout-only branch, so timeout semantics stay separate from the unresolved Allow*ExecutionRequired* boolean seeding path.
outcome_mapping.next_move: Treat timeout behavior as corroborated and keep the boolean-seeding question isolated.

outcome_mapping.review_rule: Choose this outcome when the global timer pass retains KiGlobalTimerResolutionRequests but does not provide a stronger helper/caller shortlist.
outcome_mapping.next_move: Keep the lane active-narrow and do not reopen broad runtime work yet.

outcome_mapping.review_rule: Choose this outcome when required passes lose retained anchors, regress into missing symbols, or only keep wrapper or wildcard fog.
outcome_mapping.next_move: Stop widening the lane and reacquire the exact anchor before making new claims.

red_flags: Missing retained exact symbol from one required pass.
Only wildcard listings are retained and no useful u or uf disassembly body remains.
Timeout callback output is being treated as proof of the unresolved boolean-seeding pair.
non_goals: Do not reopen a broad ETW, Procmon, or WPR replay first.
Do not widen into generic *Power* or generic *TimerResolution* symbol hunting first.
Do not treat timeout callback reconfirmation as proof of AllowSystemRequiredPowerRequests or AllowAudioToEnableExecutionRequiredPowerRequests.
